en: The *Sanniṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī*, translated by the Western Indian ancestral Chan Master Zhikong:
Oṃ bhaluṅ svāhā. Namo bhagavate sarvatrailokya...

Yebhramadivisasthāya budhāya te namo tadyathā | oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ sūdāya sūdāya visūdāya visūdāya aśamaśamanda āvapaśa aśaparāṇakaṭika kaṇa svāhā vipuṣṭe abhisīcaṃ duvaṃ sarvataḥ katu yuga tuvara vaza na ali |

Tadāpi khe kha ra ma ma mahā-vudra mantra-vati āhara āhara ma ma āyura-sandhāraṇi sudaya sudaya vi-sudaya vi-sudaya kākana svāhā vavi-suti uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-vare svasti svasti saṃjūti-te sarvathā-katā-abaddha.
Rocini śatavara vidyābalaṇi sarvatathāgatamati svāhā | pūrvī pradiś tiṣṭhati sarvatathāgata-kṛtya-acchaṭā-acchaṭe mama āyu-r-viśodhaya svāhā ||
mahāvidyunmāti mātī mahāmātī mamatī saumati tadyathā.
Vijaya vijaya sara sara samara samara.
